text:
Juno Park: hey team — Juno here, starting as infra SWE today. quick questions: 1) how long does MDM enrollment usually take? 2) who do I ping for git access to infra repos? 3) are there any must-join recurring meetings first week? fun fact: I brew espresso at home ☕

Maria - People Ops: welcome Juno!! I'll DM the onboarding checklist and add you to payroll/benefits. will also add the recurring invites. :tada:

Noah (IT): hey Juno — can pre-stage your laptop. pls confirm shipping address and preferred laptop model (macbook pro/mbp + m1/m2). provisioning link will take ~1-2 hrs after you enroll.

Juno Park: thanks Noah — shipping: 123 Maple St, Apt 5B, San Francisco, CA. MacBook Pro M2 would be great. 

Noah (IT): noted. sending provisioning link now. once you click the link, MDM + VPN setup should be straightforward. I'll monitor the ticket.

Kevin L: welcome! for git access ping @Sam R and share your GH handle. infra team access is gated by team membership but we usually get people in same day. also FYI infra sync is midweek.

Sam R: hi Juno — can you drop your GitHub handle here? happy to add you and jump on a quick screenshare to get your dev env running later today.

Juno Park: github: `junopark` — thanks Sam. Also curious about slack channels to follow for infra alerts / docs?

Kevin L: #eng-runtime for runtime/deploys, #eng-sre for incidents, and #eng-platform for infra tooling. docs are in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.com/infra

Maria - People Ops: recurring to join: All-hands Mon 10am, Infra sync Wed 2pm, and new-hire 1:1 with People Ops tomorrow at 11am — I'll add you.

it-bot: Provisioning link sent to juno@redwood.com — enroll device at https://mdm.redwood.internal/enroll and install the VPN package `redwood-vpn.pkg`.

Juno Park: got the link and started enrollment. enrolling now, will ping if anything blocks. excited to be here :smile:

Sam R: welcome again — if you want, we can pair at 4pm PT to walk through repo layout and local setup.

Kevin L: and if you're around Friday we do a casual team lunch — low-key, great way to meet people in person.

Juno Park: love that — count me in for lunch if my laptop arrives :)
